So Cabrillo's procedure might require steps that others do not." (cpl_memory sam-reconcile-pass-after-harvest-2026-10-14). A step fills a field only where the record leaves it empty, and clears one only where a step says which words the reading took it from.

_kinds.fill: pattern's min (and max) fill program.<field> when it is empty; only_without / only_with name a field that must be empty / set; skip_if_equal names a field that already holds the same figure (no double count); fills_degree_rest takes the first match whose figure is the degree total less the major's total (S713, Antelope Valley)
_kinds.clear_minimum: a sentence giving a kind of degree's least units in the major (pattern's n) is no major total: total_units equal to n is cleared, once the record reads a degree total
_kinds.order: steps run in order: a clear runs before the fills that depend on it
_kinds.awards: 'associate': the steps read associate degrees only (a certificate's page prints its own total in the same words); 'transfer': transfer degrees only (AA-T, AS-T), for a figure such as Cal-GETC that a local degree never carries though its captured page may span the sibling transfer section; 'local': an associate degree that is no transfer degree; 'local_aa' / 'local_as': a local A.A. or A.S. only, never a transfer degree, for a local pattern that asks the two a different number of units (Las Positas's LPC-GE); 'noncredit': a noncredit program by the state file's award (S644: the no-colon hours total's flag, San Bernardino Valley and Coalinga)
_kinds.set: a figure the page's words point to, set from the step's value where the field is empty: the catalog prints it once for every degree on its own page (source, source_words) or states a rule the record keeps as a flag (Cerritos's minimum of 60, its electives as needed); only_without names a field that must be empty, only_with one that must be set (Los Angeles City, S639: a heading's 'Minimum of 60' is a floor only where the record holds that total; Victor Valley's Cal-GETC, only_with degree_total). A set of electives_fill_words files the catalog's own sentence that electives fill the total, where the page never prints the word elective (Grossmont, East Los Angeles, S644): the scorer's electives guard reads it, and only where the text prints it. A step with was replaces a field holding exactly that figure (East Los Angeles, S714: a high-unit major's waived general education areas take the LACCD plan's 27 to 21); hold names records the step leaves alone, with why
_kinds.prefix_aliases: the college's subject prefixes as its catalog prints them, mapped to the state file's: the scorer reads a placed code the file lists only under the other prefix as that listed course (never one the file lists as printed). prefix_aliases_cited names each pair's evidence and source where a census wrote it (S652, kb/_prefix_alias_census.py: at least three courses of the same number and title at that college, and no number naming two different courses)
_kinds.course_renumbers: courses the college renumbered after the state's file was written, the catalog's code mapped to the file's, each pair cited by the title and units both print: read wherever prefix_aliases is (the capture's coverage, the scorer, the second reader), and never where the file lists the printed code, so a pair retires once the file catches up
_kinds.course_units: a course the record lists without units takes the units the page's own course data names (the vendor call the page made as it loaded, kept by the reader as the source's course_units): never a course the reading gave units, and the note names the call
_kinds.course_hours: a course a record measured in hours lists without hours takes the top of the hours the page's own course data names (the course_units call's lecture plus lab hours, kept by the reader as the source's course_hours; the tab's noncredit total sums the tops): only in an hours record, never a course the reading gave a figure, and the note names the call. A catalog that prints each course's hours only in its course descriptions carries them in hours_file, a committed map beside the read that printed them (Victor Valley, S639), and the note names that read
_kinds.pool_lists: several lists the reading split one choice into, pooled: where the page prints one unit figure (pattern's n) over lists each read as choose_units with no figure of their own and named with block_prefix, the lists become one choose_units block of n (name), courses in order; never one list, and never where the record's total_units names another figure; with_floors (S489) also pools lists that carry their own figures, where the page prints one total over them all: each list's figure stays in the pooled block's floors, a course listed in two of the lists counts once, and never where the floors sum past n. block_pattern (a regex on the list name) may stand in for block_prefix
_kinds.pool_areas: an area's sub-areas the reading split into blocks, under one total the page prints over the area (pattern's area and n; Hartnell's Cal-GETC 45096): the sub-area blocks block_pattern names (with {area}) become one choice of n units, each sub-area kept in floors with its rule, a course listed under two sub-areas listed once; only two or more blocks, never where the sub-areas' own printed figures sum past n
_kinds.repeat: a course or a list the page says is taken more than once (Hartnell's Music 43887): pattern's code and n give that course or alternative times n, so its units count n times; block_pattern's n, read on a choose_courses block's name the reading gave a minimum of one (or n itself, S533), makes it n enrollments from a list a student may repeat (repeats); never a figure the reading gave; a total group (Delta's "for a total of 16 units") keeps the printed sum as units_total, which the scorer reads in place of the course's units times n; n may be a word (four); name_pattern's n (and code, where it names one), read on a rule-all block's own heading, gives that block's courses alone the count, only where the heading's words are on the page and the counted sum is the block's stated figure (Norco's options, S673); a pattern's each group names one enrollment's figure ('2 x 1', Glendale S697), and the step then touches only an entry the reading gave exactly that figure
_kinds.unit_line: a requirement the page prints as a line with units and no course (Delta's Architectural Drafting 22244, "Associate Degree Math Requirement: Units 4"): pattern's label and n add a choose_units block of n with no courses, only where no block carries the label and the record's sum falls short of its printed total by exactly n
_kinds.fill_to: a list the page says fills the program to a total ("FOR A MINIMUM OF 18 UNITS", "TO COMPLETE 36 TOTAL UNITS"): block_pattern's n on a block's name gives fills_to, and the scorer reads neither end of the program's sum below it; range_pattern's n and m on a choose_courses block's name ("COMPLETE 3-4 COURSES") give the count's top as maximum where the reading kept n as its minimum (Los Angeles Valley, S534)
_kinds.or_units: an alternative the page prints as its own 'or CODE' row with no units (CourseLeaf's course list) takes its parent's units, the group's figure the page's total counts once: never an alternative the reading gave units, never a parent without them (Monterey Peninsula, S535); parent_from_block (S590) first gives a block of one course and its alternatives, read 'all' with one stated figure, that figure where the course has none (the heading line carries it: 'Select one of the following: 2 · WORK 96 · or WORK 99')
_kinds.and_units: a course the page prints joined to the row above by '&' (CourseLeaf's 'CSIS 50 · & 50L ... 3'), which the reading listed as its own entry with no units, takes 0: the row's figure is the pair's and the page's total counts it once; only where the page prints the two codes joined, the course before it carries a figure, and never a course the reading gave units (Monterey Peninsula, S536)
_kinds.semester_sum: a program laid out by semester with no printed total (Sam, Open Asks Sheet 180 card 2, 2026-11-10: count): where every block named by block_pattern is rule all and its courses add to the subtotal it prints, total_units takes the sum of the subtotals and the record carries total_units_summed; never where the record holds a total, a semester does not add up, or another block asks for units
_kinds.packed_codes: true where the college's catalog packs its course codes (De Anza's eLumen feed: C DD010G for C D 10G): the scorer reads a filed record's packed code as the listed course it names, only on the campus letter D and only when the state's file lists that course
_kinds.heading_above_code: a PDF catalog that prints a program's heading on the lines above its control number's line (Los Angeles City, S639: title, award and 'Major Units: 39  T otal Units: Minimum of 60' above '(State Code: 02718; ...)'): the capture's cut at the control number's line keeps up to `lines` lines above it, never a line `stop` names (the running header) and never a line naming a listed course, so the reconcile steps see the heading and the codes found stay the same (kb/_program_requirements_college.py heading_above)
_kinds.pdf_pages: a PDF catalog whose picker takes a program to another page than its own (Cosumnes River, S650: Psychology AA-T 30566 to a page naming it as another degree, History AA-T 33072 to the Cal-GETC pattern page): {control number: {page, words, evidence}}, the program's own PDF page (1-based) and the words its filed capture opened on there. Per program and per college, never a pattern over free catalog text (p-gate-free-text-reading-per-college-s644). Optional fields: through, the last page of a section that runs across a page break (S703); until, the words the next section opens on, where the window ends, cut exactly at both ends (S714); printed_title, the title as the catalog prints it where it drops words of the state's, for the title check (S714)
_kinds.site_pages: a site catalog whose picker hands a program a sister award's page or its department's landing page (San Bernardino Valley's CourseLeaf certificates, S720): {control number: {url, evidence}}, the program's own page. The capture reads the page whether or not its listing named it, and binds it only while the page's h1 prints the program's title with its award and the page is a candidate for the program on its own (kb/_program_requirements_college.py site_pinned); a refused pin is filed in the capture (site_pins), the program is read from no page, and its filed record stands.
